points.claim: Headroom compresses tool outputs, logs, files and RAG chunks before they reach the model — 60–95% fewer tokens on JSON, about 15–20% on coding-agent turns, reversible and local-first.
points.spoken: Headroom compresses everything your agent reads — tool output, logs, files — before the model sees it. Ninety-eight percent saved on one real task. It is reversible.
points.source_note: README tagline: 'Compress tool outputs, logs, files, and RAG chunks before they reach the LLM. 60–95% fewer tokens (JSON), 15–20% (coding agents), same answers. Library, proxy, MCP. Local-first. Reversible.' Apache-2.0; the reference video shows its terminal: tokens before 17,832, after 312.

visual.intent: compressed-context visual: a fat JSON blob squeezes into a thin chip as the token counter spins 17,832 down to 312; green RECEIPT stamp — REAL screen recording of the tool/page (interface on screen, house heading + captions over it)

points.title: Compress what the model reads
points.sub: Headroom: 60–95% fewer tokens on JSON, reversible, runs locally.

points.claim: Ponytail makes Claude Code write far less code — its own benchmarks claim roughly 54% less code and about 20% cheaper API cost.
points.spoken: Ponytail stops your agent writing ten lines where two work. Its own benchmark says fifty-four percent less code — and output tokens are the expensive ones.
points.source_note: Second-party roundup (digicuratoragency, Sep 2026): 'Ponytail makes Claude Code write far less code — 54% less code, 20% cheaper API cost in its own benchmarks. Repo: DietrichGebert/ponytail.' Flag benchmarks as the author's own.

points.title: Make it write less
points.sub: Ponytail: 54% less code in its own benchmarks, output tokens are the pricey ones.

points.claim: OmniRoute reroutes agent traffic to free model providers the moment your usage limit hits, claiming roughly 1.47 billion free tokens a month across 352 providers; Graphify maps the codebase once locally so agents stop re-reading the same files.
points.spoken: When the limit still comes, OmniRoute switches you to free models mid-session. Graphify maps your codebase once — the agent stops re-reading it.
points.source_note: Same roundup: 'OmniRoute reroutes to free model providers when your usage limit hits — ~1.47B free tokens/month across 352 providers (npm install -g omniroute). Graphify maps your codebase once via local parsing — zero API credits for code mapping (uv tool install graphifyy).' Present the 1.47B figure as their claim.

youtube.title: Claude Code Token Limit? 4 Free Plugins Kill It
youtube.description: Claude Code token limit mid-task? Four open-source plugins cut the burn from four sides. Headroom compresses everything your agent reads first (60–95% fewer tokens on JSON; one demo: 17,832 down to 312). Ponytail makes the agent write 54% less code in its own benchmarks. OmniRoute reroutes to ~350 free model providers when the limit hits. Graphify maps your codebase once locally so agents stop re-reading it. Third-party tools; numbers are vendor-reported — measure your own repo. #Shorts
